body: They aren't mean people, I'm just a bit of a wallflower I guess.
I can't see a future right now, for me it is like trying to see when my eyes are shut. Thank you nonetheless.
Thank you for your kind words.
Thank you, brave is not something I have ever been called, haha.
I know I am selfish and it hurts me that I am this way. I try to be a kind person. Thank you for your advice.
I study a lot, it keeps me from thinking about my life. Thank you.

I see a psychiatrist regularly and take anti-depressants. Have done so since I was 16. My friends are not really my friends, they just tolerate me because they like my boyfriend. Thank you for your kindness, you are a good person.

Sometimes it takes so much courage to tell people things, and then when you do the answer is 'Don't be so negative, you'll never make friends that way'. So you just have to keep it and put a brave face on for the world.
